checks.claim: White-label price floor: Alibaba screenless HRV/SpO2/sleep bands list at $8.80-$12.55/unit with MOQs of 1-100 pcs; Da Fit/MoYoung RTL8762-class watches retail at ~$7 on Amazon.
checks.evidence: The $8.80-$12.55 bracket appears only on Alibaba's own marketing page ('starting as low as'); a sibling Alibaba sourcing page for the same category quotes $9.80-$26.00, so the floor is not independently corroborated. No search result corroborated the 1-100 pc MOQ range, and the ~$7 Amazon price for RTL8762/Da Fit watches appears only in the jphein/moyoung-watch README (TechRadar's sub-$4 AliExpress band is a different, older device). Order of magnitude is plausible; the specific numbers are single-source.

checks.claim: Alibaba's OEM-vs-ODM wearable guide: full-custom OEM NRE $150k-$400k plus $50k-$120k certification and $30k+ tooling; OEM MOQ 5,000; ODM MOQ 2,000-3,000.
checks.corrected_value: Same guide: OEM $18-$32/unit at 5,000-unit MOQ with $150k-$400k NRE, $50k-$120k certifications, $30k+ tooling amortization (as cited); but ODM MOQ in that guide is 1,000 units (not 2,000-3,000) at $25-$45/unit, with $12k-$28k branding setup and $0-$15k for minor firmware tweaks. The 2,000-3,000 figure is iSmarch's stated MOQ, not Alibaba's.
checks.evidence: Search of the Alibaba guide confirms the NRE/certification/tooling figures and the 5,000-unit OEM MOQ verbatim, but gives ODM MOQ as 1,000 units and adds per-unit brackets the research file omitted. All of these numbers exist only in Alibaba marketing content; no ODM quotation corroborates them, so treat as order-of-magnitude.

checks.claim: Firmware source-code access reportedly requires MOQs up to 50,000 units; mid-tier ODM GPS smartwatch $34/unit at 2,000 units vs $29/unit OEM plus ~$210k one-time.
checks.evidence: Alibaba's smartwatch-manufacturer guide does say ODMs 'might require a much higher MOQ - like 50,000 units' for full source code, so the citation is accurate, but it is a single marketing source summarizing buyer discussions with no named vendor. The $34/$29/$210k figures were not surfaced by search even though the seller-blog URL exists; they could not be independently corroborated.

checks.claim: J-Style/Jointcorp ECG bands (JCVital V8) have MOQ 1,000 with full iOS/Android SDK + cloud API, ISO 13485, CE/FCC; iSmarch screenless bands have MOQ 2,000-3,000 on EXW quotes with SDK/protocol docs supplied.

checks.claim: Section 301 List 4A rate of 7.5% applies to 8517.62.0090-class Bluetooth consumer devices (carved out of List 1), reported under 9903.88.15.
checks.evidence: CBP CROSS rulings for Bluetooth products classified in 8517.62.0090 (e.g., N308565 wireless earbuds; a wireless intercom headset ruling summarized by Clark Hill/Lexology; a Bluetooth tracking device ruling) state that Chinese products under 8517.62.0090 are subject to an additional 7.5% ad valorem duty and must be reported with chapter 99 subheading 9903.88.15. FreightAmigo and 2026 trade guides confirm Tranche 4A remains at 7.5%.

checks.claim: 2026 tariff sequence: IEEPA tariffs struck down Feb 20, 2026; Section 122 10% global surcharge ran Feb 24 - Jul 24, 2026; forced-labor Section 301 duties effective Jul 24, 2026 at 12.5% for China and 10% for India.
checks.evidence: Supreme Court decided Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump on Feb 20, 2026 (6-3, IEEPA does not authorize tariffs; supremecourt.gov 24-1287). Skadden/PwC/GingerControl confirm the Section 122 10% surcharge took effect Feb 24, 2026 under Proclamation 11012 and expired at its 150-day limit on Jul 24, 2026. Holland & Knight, Akerman, C.H. Robinson, GHY and Wiley confirm the USTR forced-labor Section 301 final action (issued Jul 23) took effect 12:01 a.m. EDT Jul 24, 2026 at 10% or 12.5% across 60 economies, with India in the 10% tier and China at 12.5%. Newer development the file misses: the Court of International Trade struck down the Section 122 tariffs in May 2026 (appeal pending; refund implications).

checks.claim: JLCPCB economic SMT assembly: $0.0016-$0.0017 per solder joint, $8 setup, $1.50 stencil, $3 per extended part type.
checks.corrected_value: Setup fee is listed as $7.00 on JLCPCB's own assembly-price help page and as $8 in 2026 third-party guides (Hack Club, Andwin); per-joint $0.0017 (manual $0.0173), stencil $1.50 and $3.00 per unique extended component are consistent across JLCPCB pages.
checks.evidence: JLCPCB's 'PCB Assembly Cost: What Does the Price Include?' and 'In what cases will there be charged extra?' help pages give SMT assembly at $0.0017/joint, stencil $1.50, setup $7, and a $3.00 per-unique-extended-component feeder-loading fee (Preferred Extended parts exempt). The $8 setup figure appears in 2026 third-party guides, so the exact setup fee is $7-$8 depending on date; immaterial to the cost model.

The $70.6/m2 figure appears only in one GitHub cost note (maxsimmonds1337/SBS_hw). JLCPCB does not publish a per-m2 rate; its promotional 4-layer pricing (e.g., $2 for five 100x100 mm boards, i.e., ~$40/m2 promo) and third-party 2026 guides ($2-5/piece for small 4-layer boards) are not comparable to a volume laminate rate. Treat as an unanchored estimate.

summary: 17 load-bearing claims checked with 23 independent WebSearch queries before the session search budget (200/200) was exhausted. 11 confirmed against primary or multiple independent sources: Helio Strap $99/sensors/25-movement detection; Zepp Health Q3 2025 (38.2% GM, adjusted operating breakeven, +78.5% revenue); WHOOP 4.0 Maxim silicon (MAX86171/MAX32652/MAX6631 plus MAX77818) and 5-LED/4-PD optics; Section 301 List 4A 7.5% for 8517.62.0090 via 9903.88.15; the Feb 20 IEEPA ruling, Feb 24-Jul 24 Section 122 surcharge and Jul 24, 2026 forced-labor 301 rates (China 12.5%, India 10%); JLCPCB SMT per-joint/stencil/extended-part fees; 601520 LiPo small-qty prices; Ultrahuman Bengaluru + Plano/SVtronics footprint; WHOOP tiers $199/$239/$359; Dial 2025 HRV/RHR statistics. 2 corrected: Helio Strap Pro is $199.99 (announced Jun 18, 2026, dual-sensor system), and Alibaba's OEM-vs-ODM guide gives ODM MOQ 1,000 (not 2,000-3,000) with $25-45 ODM / $18-32 OEM unit brackets. 4 unverifiable: the Alibaba $8.80-12.55 band floor and Da Fit ~$7 retail (single marketing/README sources; sibling Alibaba page says $9.80-26.00), the 50k firmware-source MOQ and $34/$29/$210k ODM/OEM figures (single Alibaba source), JLCPCB $70.6/m2 4-layer rate (single GitHub note), and AFE chip prices (no distributor prices; a Shenzhen distributor snippet puts GH3026 at ~CNY 7.94, well below the ~$3 note). Biggest remaining gaps, none closable this session because the budget ran out: a real JDM quote with NRE and 5k/25k/100k unit prices, WHOOP/Oura assembly sites, any validation study of a cheap white-label PPG band, the forced-labor 301 exemption annex for 8517.62, and the Miller 2022/Bellenger 2021 numbers. Newer data the file misses: CIT struck down Section 122 in May 2026; TechInsights has a WHOOP 5.0 teardown; a Helio Strap 2 was covered in June 2026.
